facts.fact: Rádio Nacional reports that civil society (CIP, via Projeto Propalop) presented a draft access to administrative information law (anteprojeto) in October 2019, still unapproved, with no specific access to information law in force in São Tomé and Príncipe.
facts.system: anteprojeto de lei de acesso à informação administrativa

STP.note: The document says nothing on AI law.
The document says nothing on cybersecurity law.
The document says nothing on a data protection authority.
The document says nothing on data protection law.
The document says nothing on an identity law.
The document says nothing on e-commerce law.
